SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

SELECT  *
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount  BCA 
JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PERIODENDDATE,ProductId,FINANCIALPRODUCTID,PeriodStartDate,FcbsApplication FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct  ) BCAF ON convert(varchar,BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(DATE,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate) = CONVERT(DATE,BCAF.PeriodStartDate)  
JOIN DW.RefDepositVerifiedAccounts rdva on BCA.CustomerAccountId = rdva.FORACID and BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = rdva.Bnk_code and BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate = rdva.ACCT_OPN_DATE
where BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 


ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_Verify_DW_DimAccount] AS
BEGIN



SELECT * into DW.DIMACCOUNT_DEP_PREDEL_20240205 FROM DW.DimAccount A
WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM DW.RefDepositVerifiedAccounts D WHERE  D.FORACID = A.AccountID
AND CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), A.AccountOpenedDate,112) AS INT) = CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), D.ACCT_OPN_DATE,112) AS INT) ) AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP';

--DEL UNVERIFIED DIMACCOUNT--
DELETE A  FROM DW.DimAccount A
WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM DW.RefDepositVerifiedAccounts D WHERE  D.FORACID = A.AccountID
AND CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), A.AccountOpenedDate,112) AS INT) = CAST(CONVERT(CHAR(8), D.ACCT_OPN_DATE,112) AS INT) ) AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP';



--UPDATE INDICATOR = 0 --
--UPDATE DW.DimAccount
--SET
--CURRENTINDICATOR = 0
--WHERE SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'DEP';


--RANK TABLE DIMACCOUNT--
WITH DDA AS (
SELECT AccountSK, AccountID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AccountID ORDER BY ValidStartDate DESC, ValidEndDate DESC) RNK
FROM DW.DimAccount
)
SELECT * INTO #DDA FROM DDA;


--UPDATE INDICATOR AND ENDDATE--
UPDATE B 
SET
CURRENTINDICATOR = 1
,VALIDENDDATE = '9999-12-31'
FROM DW.DimAccount B
INNER JOIN #DDA A ON A.AccountSK = B.AccountSK WHERE A.RNK = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND CurrentIndicator = '0';

DROP TABLE #DDA;


END
GO
